stock.description: YesAsia Holdings Limited operates as a global e-commerce platform, specializing in the sourcing, marketing, and distribution of a diverse range of Asian fashion, lifestyle, beauty, and entertainment merchandise. The company facilitates online transactions for both business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-consumer (B2C) clients through its digital storefronts, which include yesasia.com, yesstyle.com, and asianbeautywholesale.com. YesAsia Holdings Limited was established in 1997 and its main offices are located in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
